in_marathi.name: Murthi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Murthi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hinduism, Murthi refers to a tangible representation of a deity. It is believed that worshiping the Murthi brings the deity's blessings closer to us.

in_bengali.name: Murthi
